required_before_freeze: Complete strategy implementation and code commit SHA
Complete immutable parameter manifest and SHA-256
Point-in-time eligible dataset manifest with source hashes
Exchange session calendar hash and corporate-action policy
Execution and settlement model version with fee evidence
Predeclared primary horizon, benchmark, metrics and acceptance thresholds
List of all previously accessed dates and symbols

holdout_rules.selection: Chronological date range chosen by independent custodian after development freeze
holdout_rules.access: No strategy author access to holdout labels or outcomes before freeze
holdout_rules.repeated_peeking: Prohibited; any access invalidates holdout and requires a new future period
holdout_rules.parameter_changes: Any change invalidates the holdout and requires a new freeze
holdout_rules.missing_data: Exclude and disclose; never impute future observations
holdout_rules.corporate_actions: Use only actions effective and knowable at decision time
holdout_rules.survivorship: Include delisted and suspended securities where source history permits
holdout_rules.release: Reviewer publishes signed manifest, hashes, metrics and exclusions
